title: Test the close-path SIGTERM race with a quest child in flight (N3c from the #741 review)
description: N3c from the #741 round-1 review, deferred after 0.15.1 by the leader 2026-11-21 and accepted by the round-2 Opus review (APPROVE at 69c8250b). The DEC-282 (a4) test covers only the uncaught-exception exit sweep. The close-path SIGTERM race (SIGTERM to the lore wrapper reaching the nested quest wrapper and native lore together) has no quest-child test. A second case that SIGTERMs the wrapper itself would cover it; the reviewer notes it is a timing race rather than a deterministic red, so decide the witness first (a kills.cjs-style preload may be more deterministic). Related: also model the real bin/quest.cjs behaviour (it forwards TERM once and sweeps its own group on close, no grace) rather than the fake wrapper that exits at once. Carried on LCLI-799 / opum-ai/lore-cli#741; QCLI-571 closes the underlying residual.
